nodeData.topic: Day 01 · SB 10.47.1–3 · Uddhava Arrives Among the Gopis
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.1–3 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj opens the Bhramara-gita with the gopis seeing Uddhava, who looks and dresses like Krishna, and explains that this chapter shows citra-jalpa, the 'mad' talk of the highest prema. He draws lessons from the gopis' shyness and etiquette, from Krishna's 'surprise', and from ornaments that are really the limbs of bhakti. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Sukadeva Goswami describes the young women of Vraja seeing Krishna's servant, who looks and dresses like Krishna, and wondering who he is.

children.topic: Uddhava first stays with Nanda, Yashoda
children.note:
Before meeting the gopis, Uddhava has been with Nanda Maharaja and Mother Yashoda; only afterwards do the gopis see him.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:13 (auto-transcript): “All along Uddar have been with Nala Maharaj and Maurya Yashoda. And after finishing with Nala Maharaj and Yashoda Maurya, The Gopis saw Udhava. What did they see? They observed that Udhava looked like Krishna, to some extent.”

children.topic: Long arms, a pure soul's mark
children.note:
Uddhava's hands reach his knees when he stands. Maharaj says ours reach the knee only when we bend; this uncommon symptom marks a pure soul. — “That is one of the qualities of a pure soul.”

🎙 Maharaj at 14:16 (auto-transcript): “for the spirit. Buddha had long arms. It means the hands touch the knee. When he stands, when we stand our hands will not touch the knee. We can touch the knee only when we are the city. But Uda can touch this knee when he stands. That is one of the qualities of a pure soul.”

Mother Yashoda dresses Krishna with ornaments, but in the forest he decorates himself with fresh natural flowers. Krishna identifies with nature, with no artificial life.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:27 (auto-transcript): “Krishna always wear fresh, fresh forest flowers. fresh. When Madhya Yashoda would dress Krishna very nicely with ornaments, when Krishna entered the forest, he would move to Britain. There are obstacles. Krishna will move forth and he will use natural forest flowers to…”

children.topic: Earrings: beauty in the spiritual world
children.note:
In this world usually only pujaris wear earrings, but in the spiritual world it is normal, a sign of beauty. Non-devotees looking at Krishna's form may even mistake it for a woman's.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:29 (auto-transcript): “Here in Matsusha world, it doesn't wear, usually, you don't wear earrings, except Pujaris. Yes, but in the spiritual world, it is normal, it is normal, but they also put ear in, it is a significance of beauty. So people who are not devotees, they want to see Krishna what they…”

Maharaj recalls a great devotee decorated from head to toe, which confused the brahmanas. Caitanya Mahaprabhu explained that these ornaments are the nine limbs of bhakti, not material decoration. — “They make the ornament beautiful.”

🎙 Maharaj at 19:12 (auto-transcript): “We saw in Chennai Prabhu also like this Fully decorated From the head to the toe The Brahmana school that became very confused But Chita Mahaprabhu said The only chanana, the ornament on your body, or the ornament on your body from the head to the toe, they are not just…”

children.topic: Hard to see with mundane eyes
children.note:
Many people cannot understand this because of their mundane nature; for such devotees the ornament does not make them beautiful, they make the ornament beautiful.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:17 (auto-transcript): “Just like people are confused, see you just like people are confused. Many people don't understand in this world. It is very difficult to understand, Roshua is very difficult to understand. It is very difficult to understand because of our mundane nature. So everything on the…”

Chapter 47 describes ten kinds of citra-jalpa, varieties of talk that are symptoms of mahabhava, the highest prema.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:12 (auto-transcript): “So this chapter 47 describes the 10 types of chitta-jalpa. 10 types of chitta-jalpa. Chita Jagpa means, Chita Jagpa, Chita Jagpa means what? Jagpa, you want to say Jagpa? Not one kind of talk, not one kind of talk, this is, this is Mahabhava, Prem, the symptoms of Prem.…”

Srimati Radharani chastises a bee. Maharaj asks the class whether that is normal or madness. — “Is that normal or madness?”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:28 (auto-transcript): “Because Sri Manti readily is chastising a bee. Is that normal or madness? You are some nomads, right? That's madness. Chit. That's what he says, chit jyalpa. Chitra, chitra jyalpa. So this discourse, this tale, mad discussion,”

children.topic: Madness is our word for prema
children.note:
We call it madness because that is what we can grasp, but in truth it is prema, and Srimati Radharani shows its topmost level.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:09 (auto-transcript): “So this discourse, this tale, mad discussion, We use the word madness because this is what we can honor sir. But in the real sense, in the real sense this is prema. The top most, the top most level of prema is exhibited by Srimati Perala. The word is very astonished means…”

The gopis are astonished that Uddhava wears Krishna's dhoti and garland. Maharaj asks: surprise means not knowing — is there anything the gopis or Krishna do not know? Yet Krishna himself is surprised.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:27 (auto-transcript): “Surprised. Surprised means what? Surprised, we get surprised. What is it meaning? Surprised means what? I'm surprised to see you here. We're not expecting, right? Yes. Yes. I didn't know you have so much opulence. I don't know. You are such a great person. I don't know that.…”

Cursed by Narada Muni, the two became twin arjuna trees in Nanda Maharaja's courtyard. When they were freed, Krishna said he had not recognised them, they had grown so big. — “I didn't know you have grown up to be big boys.”

🎙 Maharaj at 25:43 (auto-transcript): “When the Nardamuni blessed Nala Kuwella and Manigriwa, they became trees. You call them Arjuna trees, Jamal Arjuna trees. These Jamal Arjuna trees, the two of them, they are standing in the courtyard of Maharaja Nanda. They are standing there as trees.”

We too sometimes fail to recognise a family member after a long time. Krishna's surprise is no fault; Maharaj connects it to prema.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:43 (auto-transcript): “We feel the same way. You don't recognize a family member, sometimes, after seeing it, right? So Krishna is absolutely the same thing. That is not the fault. It is Brahma. That is prayer man, so here also the gopis has a surprise How Dabha got Krishna's duty of Krishna's gallant?”

The gopis reason that this servant resembles Krishna, so he must have news of him, and they gather around Uddhava.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:15 (auto-transcript): “news about Krishna, they are getting excited, this is a servant of Krishna, he resembles Krishna. So, he must know who Krishna is, who Krishna is. So, the gopis are going to Gada around Udhava. You know the place? Garden in the front of...”

The gopis gather around Uddhava to receive the confidential message from Krishna. A message from one's beloved is not read in public.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:16 (auto-transcript): “They gather together to give him the confidential letter from Krishna. When we have confidential letter from the sweet heart, from the sweet heart it's confidential when Krishna got a letter from Rukmini after reading the letter what did he do What did you do with the letter?…”

Maharaj asks what Krishna did with Rukmini Devi's letter after reading it. Burn it? Never — he slept with it under his pillow, still reading it in his dream. — “Krishna put it under his pillow and he slept there.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:49 (auto-transcript): “when Krishna got a letter from Rukmini after reading the letter what did he do What did you do with the letter? After Krishna read it. After reading the letter, what did you do with the letter? Burn Lukomeni Devi's letter? Krishna would never do that. Never! Never! What did…”

So Uddhava must deliver the message in a secluded place, and the gopis would read such a letter line by line, word by word.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:47 (auto-transcript): “So the gopis will keep the letter and be reading it line by line, one by word, because every word is nectar, bow down their heads in humility, the gopis duly hold on whatever word they Their shy, smiling glances and pleasing words, they took him to a quiet place,”
The gopis shyly honour Uddhava, welcome him, take him to a secluded spot and begin questioning him as Krishna's messenger.

Covering the head and feeling shy before a respectable person is a natural quality of a responsible lady. Maharaj says it is not foolishness; it has a potency that can control anyone.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:28 (auto-transcript): “Yes, it is natural quality of a responsible lady. Natural shyness in her. It's an exalted quality, shyness, exalted. It is not foolishness. It's an exalted quality. and he has a potency that can control anyone.”

To get something wonderful: no arrogance, shyness and pleasing speech. The person must feel comfortable with us, or he will not speak freely. — “Then he can release everything, all the secret will come out.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:02 (auto-transcript): “If you want to get something wonderful, this is the etiquette, get something wonderful, low arrogance, shyness, to speak blissingly. The person should be comfortable in our association If he doesn't feel comfortable”

The gopis feel Krishna has already cheated them with sweet talk — what message will he send now? Yet they are eager to hear what Uddhava has brought.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:28 (auto-transcript): “Krishna has already deceived Gopis. That's how they feel, Krishna. But his sweet talk, he has already cheated on. What is he going to do again? What message is he going to tell? But they are eager to hear what Budapra has for them. Hare Krishna. Any comments, questions?”

Maharaj invites comments and questions.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:11 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna. Any comments, questions?”

A devotee's comment about the gopis' dressing is not recorded; it is inferred from the answer.

🎙 Question from the floor at 40:11 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna. Any comments, questions?”

Dressing nicely does not mean expensive dress: simple, clean and smart, the head covered so nothing falls into the food, without spending hours.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:57 (auto-transcript): “Dressing nicely doesn't mean expensive dressing, very expensive. and clean. Very simple, clean, smart. Their dresses doesn't fly everywhere.”

children.topic: Sharp minds do it in minutes
children.note:
Those whose heart is clean and sharp do in two minutes what takes a dull-minded person an hour.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:28 (auto-transcript): “And for those, for those whose heart is clean and sharp, They will do things which can take a dull-minded person one hour to do in two minutes. See the person in the mood of darkness.”

children.topic: An hour to put paste on brush
children.note:
Maharaj describes someone in the mode of darkness who wakes and does nothing, then spends an hour in the bathroom while ten people wait. — “It means the mind is dull.”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:08 (auto-transcript): “See the person in the mood of darkness. When they wake up from sleep, you see the day doing nothing. When they wake up from sleep, one hour pass, you see Romney around, Romney around. I don't know, you were slept with me, I don't know.”

Because the gopis are fully Krishna conscious, their bathing, dressing, eating, talking and walking are all for Krishna, so everything is perfect and complete.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:14 (auto-transcript): “So, because the gopis are fully Krishna conscious, everything they do, it is for Krishna. They are bathing, they are dressing, they are eating, they are talking, they are walking. Everything is about Krishna, just Krishna. So in this way, all their things are perfect and…”

children.topic: Ornaments that come on their own
children.note:
On pilgrimage Nityananda Prabhu gave thousands of cows to local brahmanas without travelling with any — they were simply present. Before Panihati, the ornaments he desired came by themselves.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:01 (auto-transcript): “We see Lord Netanyahu Prabhu is on pilgrimage. You see cows with him? Was he travelling with millions of cows? No. Then how did he give thousands of cows to local Brahmanas, wherever he went? How is he getting there? He just manufactured them there immediately. There is open…”

He called no goldsmith or disciple; the ornaments came because they are his property and fitted his fingers and toes exactly. — “no oversize no undersize perfect”

🎙 Maharaj at 49:15 (auto-transcript): “He didn't call disciples to bring anything. they came on their own because they are his properties and everything that came they all perfectly fit the fingers and the toes completely no oversize no undersize perfect so he decorated himself just like he put on dress these are…”

He came to teach, so he had this paraphernalia; ordinary people see things, but those with eyes see the nine limbs of bhakti appearing as ornaments.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:06 (auto-transcript): “to teach, so people don't have ideas, so ordinary things, but those who have the eyes, They could see these are ornaments. This is a nine limbs of bhakti appearing as ornaments. Yes, if you have something, if you have bhakti, means bhakti pram is with you.”

children.topic: If we have bhakti, all come
children.note:
If prema-bhakti is with us, all its limbs are present too. Ambarisa performed all nine, so he had all; Sanatana Goswami says the residents of Vaikuntha have all six opulences. — “If we have them, they will be present also.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:50 (auto-transcript): “Yes, if you have something, if you have bhakti, means bhakti pram is with you. Pram bhakti is with you, right? So all of them were present. If we have them, they will be present also. We should have it, so that way too. That means also that Ambarisman has all the nine,…”

maps.title: Bhramara-gita · Day 02 · SB 10.47.4–10 · Love That Never Breaks

nodeData.topic: Day 02 · SB 10.47.4–10 · Love That Never Breaks
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.4–10 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The gopis tease Uddhava and accuse Krishna of remembering only his parents and of leaving them as a bee leaves a flower. Maharaj explains that material friendship is mutual cheating, while pure love does not break even with a thousand reasons, and that Krishna secretly enjoys the gopis' accusations because they come from a pure heart. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The gopis tell Uddhava they know he is Krishna's personal servant, sent to please Krishna's parents.

The gopis reason that the cowherd boy has become a big man with a big position and opulence. Progress means going up — what would he do with a village? — “So what will he do with the village?”

🎙 Maharaj at 06:55 (auto-transcript): “Even though Krishna is of the Calvary community, he is now living as a person If one has acquired the big position then no light will come down because I did not progress.”

Krishna himself told Arjuna that for one who has been honoured, dishonour is worse than death; so he will not come down.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:29 (auto-transcript): “Krishna himself told Arjuna, one who has been honoured, this honour is worse than death. So he would not come down. He would go up. The gopis are teaching Buddha. He is saying he would come and represent him. Will you represent him? You have all the qualities of Krishna that…”

The gopis tease Uddhava: you have all Krishna's qualities — will you represent him? Maharaj notes that counsellors usually do not share their master's qualities; often they are opposite.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:52 (auto-transcript): “The gopis are teaching Buddha. He is saying he would come and represent him. Will you represent him? You have all the qualities of Krishna that we need. You have all his qualities. The counselors, they have the same quality with the Guru, but the counselors, they have all the…”

In the gopis' view Krishna is political: knowing people would criticise him, he sends Uddhava to pacify his parents while he stays away. — “Krishna behaves like human beings.”

🎙 Maharaj at 12:07 (auto-transcript): “In other words, Krishna, Krishna, political, he knows people are going to criticize him So he is sending you to come and pacify his parents, sellers, nobody will criticize him Nanda and Yashvattham may cry themselves to death, but Krishna will simply stay in whatever would…”

children.topic: Tulasi's curse: a heart like stone
children.note:
Because Krishna behaves like a human being, Tulasi Devi cursed him: your heart is like stone. Krishna accepted — he would be the salagrama stone, and she would remain as a plant.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:21 (auto-transcript): “That's why Tulsi Devi crossed him. You have no heart, your heart is like stool, whether it be a stool. Kishnah say yes, no problem, how he is stool. So, Salangrava, Shilangrava. It is Kishnah, your heart is like stool. So it will be a stone Yes I am a stone But what she can…”

The gopis' words are very pointed and hide many meanings. Their criticism and their praise are the same thing. — “Their praising is criticism, their criticism is glorification.”

🎙 Maharaj at 17:48 (auto-transcript): “The gopis are very, very poignant, very, very poignant. Whatever word they say, hides varieties of beings. So, their criticism or their praise is all the same. Their praising is criticism, their criticism is glorification. We see nothing else in mind to consider what…”
The gopis say they see nothing in Vraja for Krishna to remember except his family, since family affection binds even sages.

Caitanya Mahaprabhu would say the same: affection for family members is very difficult to break, even for a sage.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:22 (auto-transcript): “Sri Chaitanya Mahabur would say the same thing. Bhagavan Chaitanya Mahabur would say this. The affections for one's family members are very difficult to break Even for a siege Therefore Krishna sent you to see his parents, it is not for us”

children.topic: What can Krishna not give up?
children.note:
Maharaj asks: if Krishna could leave the gopis even in the midst of their dance, what is there he cannot give up? The answer, partly unclear, is that they are his own self, extremely dear.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:51 (auto-transcript): “If Krishna can give up the succession of gopis, what do we enter into the peak of their dancing? So what is it that Krishna cannot give up? Gubhya, our Krishna Bhagavan, was on the night's night's day, and then the Krishna was on the night's day. But after that, there was a…”

children.topic: Touch one monkey, face them all
children.note:
Family affection is strong even in monkeys: try to tamper with one and see what the others do to you. Yet the gopis say Krishna does not care.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:39 (auto-transcript): “How dutiful is a monkey? How dutiful is a monkey? Dutiful You don't have to keep a monkey as a pet. I know you have to. Why? Not beautiful. But just try, just try to tamper with the monkey and see what other monkeys will do to you.”
The gopis contrast family bonds with friendships that last only as long as some purpose is served.

Material friendship is cheating, so it ends nowhere. Two empty people come together, each expecting the other to fill the void; hence disappointment and dissatisfaction. — “I am empty, you are empty, but each of us is thinking”

🎙 Maharaj at 31:39 (auto-transcript): “The friendship which we have in the material world is not friendship, it is cheating and that is why it doesn't end anywhere. We are coming together, what is the motive that two people come together, what is the motive? I am empty, you are empty, but each of us is thinking I…”

Devotees answer that pure love is unconditional and unmotivated. Maharaj adds: with no material motive, even thousands of good reasons cannot break it; if it breaks, it was only a shadow.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:02 (auto-transcript): “When there is pure, when there is pure, when the love is pure. No material motivation Even if there are hundreds or thousands of reasons to break, it does not break, that is pure love There are thousands of reasons, bona fide reasons to break But it does not break. That is…”

children.topic: Trying to remove Krishna from her heart
children.note:
A devotee praised Srimati Radharani: everyone struggles to keep Krishna in the heart, but she prays seriously to remove him — and the more she tries, the deeper he goes. — “That is pure love.”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:38 (auto-transcript): “One devotee was appreciating Srivati Dalai, he said, all over the universe, people have been struggling seriously to get Krishna planted in their heart. This is not what we are looking for. We want Krishna. Stay in our hearts. But you know what she does every day?”

Pure Krishna consciousness is like a very hot sweet drink: it burns the tongue, yet once you have tasted it you cannot stop drinking. — “It burns the tongue, but you cannot stop drinking it”

🎙 Maharaj at 39:28 (auto-transcript): “because pure Krishna consciousness It's like very hot. If you drink it, it will burn your tongue. But the taste, you have tasted it from drinking it. It will not stop you from drinking it. Even though you burn your tongue, you should drink it.”

children.topic: Go for it — that is life
children.note:
So Maharaj urges us to go for it, because that is real life.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:38 (auto-transcript): “Therefore You should go for it You should go for it Because that is life The Gopis continue. Prostitute abandon a penniless man. Subjects. Yes, prostitute will abandon a”
The gopis list examples of people and creatures who abandon what no longer benefits them.

The gopis apply the examples to Krishna: after enjoying them he left, just as a bee takes honey from one flower and goes to another.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:29 (auto-transcript): “They are talking about Krishna So they are giving an example Krishna has abandoned us after enjoying us The same way prostitute does with a perilous man After the student finished their education They are gone No relationship with the teacher, they don't care for the teacher…”

Students forget their teacher after finishing; workers leave a director who cannot pay. Our relationships here rest on what we can get from each other.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:53 (auto-transcript): “After the student finished their education They are gone No relationship with the teacher, they don't care for the teacher again. If a king has no money to pay or a director has no money to pay the workers, they look for a different company. So our relationship here is based…”

children.topic: Krishna pretends to sleep and listens
children.note:
This talk gives Krishna enjoyment. He pretends to sleep so that he can hear the gopis' accusations.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:56 (auto-transcript): “but this this kind of talk is giving Krishna enjoyment he says Krishna here in this pretend to sleep because I was pretending to sleep so he can hear this accusation he's not sleeping but because he want to hear his criticism once we hear someone blaspheming your”

Maharaj asks who wants to hear criticism, and answers: one who wants to improve. — “First you want to improve. You will listen to the criticism.”

🎙 Maharaj at 46:52 (auto-transcript): “criticizing. Who wants to hear? Very good. First you want to improve. You will listen to the criticism. Prabhu sit down, I have your file. So sit down, let me point out all of them.”

children.topic: Prabhu, sit down, I have your file
children.note:
Maharaj jokingly lists a devotee's 'faults': you wake up too early, chant too loud, read every day, starve your body, hardly sleep.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:24 (auto-transcript): “Prabhu sit down, I have your file. So sit down, let me point out all of them. Have a seat. I want to count all your faults. You wake up too early. Right? You wake up too early. You chant too loud. You read every day. You cannot attend to anybody because anytime you come you…”

Maharaj cites an acarya that hair stood on end all over Krishna's body as he listened, until he had to open his eyes. There is no malice in the gopis' hearts, so it is glorification. — “Therefore, it is a glorification, not a condemnation”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:18 (auto-transcript): “There is a sign in the beloved. Yes, Guru Mangal Takura said, The ghost pimples are coming out from Krishna's body. What is hearing? And pimples all over Krishna's body. As he is pretending to sleep, he couldn't sleep, he gradually opened his eyes, because he did it. There is…”

children.topic: Our critics may hate; hear anyway
children.note:
Criticism we receive often comes from envy, to bring us down, so we react. But one who wants to advance should hear it, wherever it comes from.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:35 (auto-transcript): “But when we get criticism, it is from eight years mind, it is hatred, it is to bring you down, so I can stand, therefore, it will react negatively. But for anyone who wants to make advancements, it doesn't matter where it is coming from, you should hear it.”
Absorbed in Govinda, the gopis set aside their work and sing of Krishna's childhood and youth, weeping before his messenger.

In a private place, seeing Uddhava as no different from their friend Krishna, the gopis are not ashamed to reveal their intimate dealings in front of him.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:33 (auto-transcript): “The Gopis, they took whatever to a private place, where they sit alone, outsiders are not there. And they are not seeing Uddhava different from their friend Krishna They are not ashamed that Uddhava is among them to hear their intimate dealings with Krishna So it is said…”

Questions from devotees at the end.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:54 (auto-transcript): “You have been told in the beginning of the chapter that Radha Rani is talking about the Dharma. It is a Mahabhavaka. We have seen that Radhila, when the Bhagavad Gita is a romantic, But the Gopi also talks about the Yes, we hear it like that. That she is Mahabhava. Yes, we…”

A devotee asks whether the other gopis also speak in Radharani's mood of mahabhava.

🎙 Question from the floor at 59:54 (auto-transcript): “You have been told in the beginning of the chapter that Radha Rani is talking about the Dharma. It is a Mahabhavaka. We have seen that Radhila, when the Bhagavad Gita is a romantic, But the Gopi also talks about the Yes, we hear it like that. That she is Mahabhava. Yes, we…”

These gopis are her expansions, so they share the experience. Those who facilitate the love between Radha and Krishna get even more. — “That is how pure love operates.”

🎙 Maharaj at 60:41 (auto-transcript): “But these Gopis are a high expansion. So they will have experience. Not to her labor, but they will have the remorse. That is what they are experiencing. The love which Radha and Krishna express for each other The gopis who facilitate that”

children.topic: Q2 · How to love this Krishna?
children.note:

children.topic: Don't you see I'm cheating you?
children.note:
Maharaj answers that he too 'cheats' them: every day he forces them to come, takes their sleep and leisure and gives it all to Krishna. — “Don't you see I'm cheating you, sir?”

🎙 Maharaj at 66:39 (auto-transcript): “Don't you see I'm cheating you, sir? You don't see? You don't see? Can't you see? Every day I'm forcing you to come to where I am. What is that? What is that? I'm cheating, you are sleeping, I'm cheating, you are extracting, I'm cheating, give all these things. Come to where…”

Anyone who feels indifferent is not advancing; one who feels this is what I want is making advancement. The gopis' chastisement pleases Krishna because it is pure prema, not mundane.

🎙 Maharaj at 68:19 (auto-transcript): “Anyone who feels indifferent, is not making amassment. Anyone who feels interested, this is what I want. That's basically making amassment. Because I have already mentioned Why the gopis are criticizing, chastising Krishna and he is getting enjoyment from it, because it is…”

A gopi asks why Krishna left the city for the forest. Radharani answers: where in the city could he do his nonsense, like being a self-appointed tax collector, without being caught? Krishna is proud of it.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:25 (auto-transcript): “A Gopi asked Krishna, My Jai Krishna. He was living in a city before. Why do you abandon the city to come and stay in the forest? Hearing these pure dealings increases our interest in Krishna and purifies us. Maharaj quotes an acarya's lament of separation and urges us to mature. — “Let's make our Krishna consciousness mature.”

nodeData.topic: Day 03 · SB 10.47.11–12 · Radharani Speaks to the Bee
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.11–12 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Radharani sees a bumblebee and, speaking to it instead of Uddhava, scolds it as the friend of a cheater. children.note:

children.topic: The servant's offence is the master's
children.note:
When Jaya and Vijaya stopped the Kumaras, and when Varuna's servant arrested Nanda Maharaja, the masters took the offence as their own. Disciples' acts go to the guru, citizens' to the king, workers' to the director.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:43 (auto-transcript): “When Jai and Vijaya stopped the Kumaras, Krishna told them, the offense committed by my servant are actually done by me. On a harinama tour Maharaj stayed with a devotee; on the second day the husband and wife quarrelled, and Maharaj left at once. If your hosts quarrel, you are not a good guest. — “not a very good guest you better go”

Radharani warns the bee, as the friend of a cheater, to keep away from her feet, and mocks Krishna for sending such a messenger.

children.topic: Gopis don't do austerity; we do
children.note:
The gopis sacrifice nothing, because they are naturally Krishna conscious. We consciously give things up — like sleep, to rise at two o'clock — and that is austerity.

We are pursuing austerity, we are sacrificing something for something higher. So austerity is different. We are cultivating knowledge is different. The gopis did not sacrifice anything…”

Even when we become pure and go back, we will be new devotees there, unable to tell a building from its reflection or a tree from its shadow, and the residents will laugh.

nodeData.topic: Day 04 · SB 10.47.13 · Like a Bee Leaving the Flowers
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.13 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Radharani says Krishna tasted the gopis' love once and left them as a bee leaves flowers, and calls him merciless and fickle. Maharaj shows how these accusations are glorification: Krishna is the only enjoyer, thinks only of the gopis even in Dvaraka, and is restless with love for Radharani. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Radharani compares Krishna's leaving the gopis to a bee leaving flowers, and wonders why the goddess of fortune still serves him.

nodeData.topic: Day 06 · SB 10.47.16 · Sweet Words, No Action
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.16 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Radharani pushes the bee away from her feet and says its flattering words were learned from its master, who abandoned those who gave up everything for him. Maharaj tells how Krishna himself finished Jayadeva's line about begging for Radharani's feet, shows how pure devotees refuse comfort to protect their bhakti, and explains that her harsh words are really a call for love — while warning that Krishna cannot tolerate offences to his devotees. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Radharani tells the bee that its flattering words come from its master, who left those who gave up everything for him, and refuses to make up. Maharaj asks: what is she really doing?

nodeData.topic: Day 07 · SB 10.47.17 · The Cruel Deeds of the Dark Boy
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.17 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Radharani lists the 'cruel' deeds of Krishna's past avatars — Vali shot from hiding, Surpanakha disfigured, Bali bound after his gift — yet admits she cannot stop talking about him. Maharaj tells each story with the real reasons behind it, shows that this criticism is an expression of deep love, and urges devotees to check how their words, deeds and thoughts affect others. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 08 · SB 10.47.18 · One Drop of Nectar
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.18 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Radharani says that even one drop of Krishna's pastimes makes people abandon home and family and wander Vrindavan as beggars. Maharaj makes this the measure of real hearing — like Rukmini, whoever truly hears of Krishna is left with only one direction — and in the questions talks about family resistance, not suppressing the urge to renounce, and the spiritual master's pleasure. nodeData.topic: Day 09 · SB 10.47.19 · Talk About Something Else
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.19 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Radharani asks the bee to speak of something else, regretting that she trusted Krishna's sweet words. Maharaj contrasts cheap sweet talk with Krishna's own admission that he can never repay the gopis, and explains that even their harsh words keep them constantly absorbed in him — true love has no breaks and no conditions. The recording is very rough, so this map is thin. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

maps.title: Bhramara-gita · Day 10 · SB 10.47.20–21 · Restless Krishna and the Sweet Village

nodeData.topic: Day 10 · SB 10.47.20–21 · Restless Krishna and the Sweet Village
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.20–21 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj speaks of Krishna's restless nature as the gopis see it, and of how the original Krishna of Vrindavan never really leaves. Through the question whether Krishna still remembers his father's home and friends, he contrasts the simple, open dealings of the village and of friendship with the guarded opulence of the city, and the queens' divided affection with the gopis' single-minded love. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse in which Radharani asks the bee whether her beloved has sent it back to her again. Maharaj opens the theme of Krishna's restless nature.

Maharaj draws out that, in the gopis' eyes, restlessness belongs to Krishna's very nature, not to a passing mood.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:10 (auto-transcript): “Restlessness is Christian nation. The term is gristless. So he would leave Venaman, he would leave Ventura, he would leave Dorica, he would leave herself, he would leave everything. And when the government says, I was going to disappear, I was going to disappear, I was going…”

Krishna left Vrindavan and everything in it, and she became restless and cried a great deal.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:18 (auto-transcript): “So he would leave Venaman, he would leave Ventura, he would leave Dorica, he would leave herself, he would leave everything. And when the government says, I was going to disappear, I was going to disappear, I was going to disappear. Left, she was going to leave, she was going…”

Mathura is so close that anyone could go to him; Maharaj notes Krishna is the son of a respectable gentleman, yet he stays away.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:05 (auto-transcript): “Matura is so close to another that each person may even come to him. He is the son of a respectable gentleman. nodeData.topic: Day 11 · SB 10.47.22–27 · Uddhava Bows to the Gopis' Love
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.22–27 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Uddhava begins to give Krishna's message and first glorifies the gopis, whose minds belong to Krishna in a way no other devotee's do. Maharaj explains that practices like charity, vows, Ekadasi and austerity become bhakti only when consciously offered for Krishna's pleasure, and that the gopis brought a standard of love from Goloka that is seen nowhere else. In the questions he speaks of each soul's natural place in the spiritual world and of Krishna maintaining those who depend on him. nodeData.topic: Day 12 · SB 10.47.28–29 · A Message That Hides Its Meaning
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.28–29 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Uddhava delivers Krishna's confidential message that the gopis are never separated from him. Maharaj shows how its philosophical surface deliberately bewilders proud scholars while its inner meaning speaks only of love, with stories of the boatman and the scholar, Lalita's failed attempt to teach Radharani Mayavada, and Sarvabhauma lecturing Caitanya Mahaprabhu. He explains that separation is the nourishment of prema, and in the questions teaches how to study, and how to tame the mind by neglecting it and engaging it in planning service. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Uddhava presents himself as his master's confidential servant and gives the message: Krishna is present in everything and everyone, so the gopis are never apart from him.

Maharaj stresses that this message is confidential, not ordinary. — “It's not ordinary message. Confidential.”

nodeData.topic: Day 13 · SB 10.47.30–31 · Present in Every State of Mind
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.30–31 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Krishna's message continues: he creates, keeps and withdraws the universe within himself, and is perceived through waking, dreaming and deep sleep. Maharaj explains how matter comes from spirit yet needs a conscious Krishna, how Yogamaya and Tulasi arrange Krishna's pastimes, and why no one understands Krishna without his mercy. He then teaches mindful sleep, neglecting the mind and chanting anyway, and answers the previous day's puzzle about where Krishna was during the sacrifice. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Day 14 · SB 10.47.32–39 · Near the Mind, Far from the Eyes
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.32–39 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Krishna's message teaches that mind control is the goal of every path and that he stays far away to draw the gopis' minds closer. Maharaj gives the gopis' fiery replies — no philosophy, no bitter neem, no doctor without a diagnosis — and their questions to Krishna about the three kinds of lovers. He applies the point to visiting holy places and to how a disciple behaves when the guru is away. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Krishna's message compares the mind's pull toward sense objects to a dream that lingers after waking, and calls for the mind to be controlled. Maharaj reads the verse and purport.

Maharaj says some of us carry the dream through our whole life, because the mind has accepted the illusion as real. One is a yogi only when that illusion is removed.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:13 (auto-transcript): “A person who is careful and alert. Knowledge is evidenced by the simply behavior of persons in the past. Can you adjust this thing? When one is worse from dream, woke up from sleep, dream that one had, and some of us, some of us will continue our dream the whole lifetime.”

Controlling the senses while the mind runs free is still failure, since the senses work under the mind. The whole of yoga is mind control. — “So the whole process of yoga is to control the mind.”

🎙 Maharaj at 14:25 (auto-transcript): “If the senses are controlled, but the mind is not controlled, then it's still a failure. Because the senses don't work independently, they are under the control of the mind. It's what the mind accepts that the senses will focus on. So the whole process of yoga is to control…”
The verse names mind control as the goal toward which every path of the Vedas flows, as rivers flow to the sea.

nodeData.topic: Day 15 · SB 10.47.40–43 · Spiritual Jealousy and Sweet Lamentation
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.40–43 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The gopis wonder whether Krishna, now among the city women, ever remembers them or the nights of the rasa dance. Maharaj shows that their jealousy and lament are really bliss and constant meditation on Krishna, and warns through Madhavendra Puri's story that neophytes misunderstand such moods. He urges every devotee to practise spiritual lamentation. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:

maps.title: Bhramara-gita · Day 16 · SB 10.47.44–52 · Gokula Is Drowning

nodeData.note: SB 10.47.44–52 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The gopis wonder why Krishna, now a king, would return to cowherd life, and admit they cannot give up hope of him, as the goddess of fortune never leaves his chest. Everything in Vraja — rivers, hills, footprints — keeps him in their hearts, which he has already stolen. Maharaj describes Vrindavan's desire trees and mysterious places, and the gopis' cry for Krishna to lift drowning Gokula. maps.title: Bhramara-gita · Day 17 · SB 10.47.53–57 · Uddhava Stays in Vraja

nodeData.topic: Day 17 · SB 10.47.53–57 · Uddhava Stays in Vraja
nodeData.note: SB 10.47.53–57 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Relieved by Krishna's message, the gopis honour Uddhava, who stays on for months speaking of Krishna until the months feel like a moment. Maharaj explains that Krishna-katha with pure devotees is not different from Krishna, that being controlled by love is no fault, and that Uddhava bowing to the gopis shows spiritual position is above social rank. In the questions he speaks of death, connection with the guru, and transparent service. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Their fever of separation relieved, the gopis honour Uddhava as non-different from Krishna, and he stays on for months, bringing joy to all of Gokula by speaking of Krishna.

Krishna was not physically in Vrindavan, yet Uddhava forgot to return to where he was. Speaking of Krishna's pastimes with his pure devotees is not different from Krishna. — “That is how sweet Krishna Katha is.”

Krishna-katha is nectar for the ear, mind, tongue and every sense; Uddhava and the gopis kept drinking and forgot Krishna was waiting for him.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:45 (auto-transcript): “It is nectar for the ear, for the mind, for the tongue, for the senses, it's nectar. In the commentary, Krishna's message tells the gopis to close their eyes, as the cowherd boys did at the forest fire. In a flash Yogamaya compresses ages of time into one moment.

How does Krishna cross the whole forest every day, from Raman Reti to Govardhana? He doesn't walk like us; Yogamaya brings the places together. — “It doesn't have to work like us.”

🎙 Maharaj at 15:28 (auto-transcript): “That is not a difficulty. Very easy. Krishna travels the whole forest every day. How does he do that? He goes to the whole forest every day. It is very easy. How does Krishna do that?”

Uddhava enjoys Vraja's rivers, forests and hills, reminding everyone of Krishna, and, delighted by the gopis' absorption, sings in their praise.

Everything here — rivers, forests, mountains, valleys, flowering trees — is enjoyable because it is connected with Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:25 (auto-transcript): “Everything here remains a pure devotee of our Krishna. Everything. the rivers the forest the mountains the valleys and flowering trees very very enjoyable”

children.topic: A ksatriya bows to cowherd girls
children.note:
Ksatriyas rank above vaisyas socially, but that is not spiritual. Understanding the gopis' position, Uddhava bows to the dust of their feet. — “that superiority is not spiritual.”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:57 (auto-transcript): “Chhatriyas are superior to the vaishyas, that superiority is not spiritual. The gopis are supposed to be bhaishas, extremely superior to all. Therefore, Udhava, who has had the mercy of Krishna,”

The gopis' association made Uddhava like them — the main reason Krishna sent him. Maharaj wishes everyone the same success.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:04 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, the association of the gopis made Udhhoji like themselves. This is the main reason that Krishna sent him here. His goal of coming to a bride was fulfilled. I wish all of you success in their Krishna consciousness. How do you get it? Comments?”

Three questions after the class.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:26 (auto-transcript): “Shira Gurdjieva, some people, when at the time of death, we see that they are very bold, very courageous, or happily leaving the body, to see. And some people, we see that they are in so much suffering. So those people who are leaving the body with courage, smiling face, or…”

Why do some people leave the body bravely and happily, and others in great suffering?

🎙 Question from the floor at 37:26 (auto-transcript): “Shira Gurdjieva, some people, when at the time of death, we see that they are very bold, very courageous, or happily leaving the body, to see. And some people, we see that they are in so much suffering. So those people who are leaving the body with courage, smiling face, or…”

A ksatriya may not be a pure devotee, yet he dies fighting happily because he knows he is going to heaven for better enjoyment.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:55 (auto-transcript): “a Chhatriya would be very happy to die fighting. He is not a pure devotee, may not be a pure devotee, but by nature he is courageous. What is making him so courageous about that? He knows that he is going to heaven.”

One who dies lamenting, angry or fearful — my house, my money, left for relatives who never liked me — is going down. — “means he is going down.”

🎙 Maharaj at 38:54 (auto-transcript): “The person who is living in the body lamenting, angry, fearful, means he is going down. He didn't succeed to go up. He is going down. Therefore, he is lamenting. What is he lamenting about? Oh, my property, my heart, my wife, my children, my cars,”

Devotees going back to Godhead leave with indescribable happiness. Dhruva told death to wait, offered obeisances, thanked the sages for their association and left peacefully.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:05 (auto-transcript): “Dhruva Maharaj he told he told wait they waited no one can tell Yamaraj to wait No body can do that. Not even Yamaraj.”

A devotee compares the gopis and Uddhava with the talks of Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya and Caitanya Mahaprabhu.

🎙 Question from the floor at 44:56 (auto-transcript): “But in the end, we often read Chaitanya Chaitanya, so we have a conversation about Sahagam Bhattacharya and Chaitanya Mahaprabhu's conversation. So, do you agree with each other, or do you agree with each other? Sahagam Bhattacharya and Chaitanya Mahaprabhu. Right now we are…”

Maharaj says the conversations differ, but pure devotees' activities are not on the bodily platform; internally they share the same experience.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:25 (auto-transcript): “they are also not on the body platform. The activities are also on the sister platform. So they have the same experience. Internally that's going on. See the cow headmen also trick the cows around. So they are good, also.”

children.topic: Q3 · Seeing the guru as Krishna
children.note:
The gopis saw Uddhava as non-different from Krishna. Does a disciple see the spiritual master that way?

🎙 Question from the floor at 48:22 (auto-transcript): “When they close eyes, they saw the krishna, the past time. Millions of this came moment, and after that, when they opened their eyes, so they saw Pudha, and they saw none different from Krishna, and as well as they worshipped him and respected him. So whether this also…”

A bona fide disciple is connected with the guru, and what the guru experiences flows through to him like a current. Without connection we see nothing.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:14 (auto-transcript): “is connected with the Guru. Whatever the Guru is experiencing, he will experience it. The current will leak through whatever is connected, he will experience it. That is why we are saying this many times, if you are a genuine devotee,”

A devotee in Mumbai said he would worship his guru once he knew the guru was pure. Maharaj laughed: how will you know if you are not a bona fide disciple? — “Krishna will show you a bona fide guru.”

🎙 Maharaj at 51:27 (auto-transcript): “I asked one devotee in Mumbai. I asked him, Prabhu, what will you do if you get to understand your Guru is a pure devotee? What will you do? What will you do when you know that you will be a guru-suddha? Ah, I will worship him. So I was laughing at him. You are a fool. You…”

Caitanya Mahaprabhu could not hide from Ramananda Raya, nor Krishna from the gopis; when Radharani came, his four-armed form lost two arms. Connection reveals.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:31 (auto-transcript): “Did Chaitanya Mahaprabhu succeed in hiding from Ramana Rai? Did he succeed? Chaitanya Mahaprabhu tried to hide himself from Ramana Rai. Did he succeed? He succeeded? No. Why? They are connected. Krishna tried to hide away from gopis. Did he succeed? Why? They are connected.”

Genuine devotees see what Krishna does for them and keep thanking him. Sanatana Gosvami and the Pandavas never asked, why am I suffering?

🎙 Maharaj at 56:39 (auto-transcript): “And remain telling Krishna thank you Otherwise we are blaming Krishna Why? Why am I suffering like this? We are suffering like this because we are sinful. Did Sanatana Goswami say that to Krishna? Did he tell Krishna like that? Why am I suffering like this Krishna? Why?…”

children.topic: Not a distraction to the guru
children.note:
A devotee is a friend to all. Do not think the guru takes all karma so you can keep sinning; serve transparently — even clean the kitchen after cooking for him. The cheater is cheated, the sincere blessed. — “Disciples should not be a distraction in Guru's mission.”

nodeData.topic: Day 18 · SB 4.8.39–42 · Narada's Expert Advice to Dhruva
nodeData.note: SB 4.8.39–42 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Though listed as SB 10.47.58, this recording takes up Dhruva Maharaja: Narada tests the boy, then tells him to absorb himself in bhakti and go to Madhuvana. Maharaj stresses rigid practice (Prabhupada's 75 percent), transparent dealings between guru and disciple, the levels of guru, and why we visit holy places. Questions cover devotee suicide, a balanced movement, purity, enemies, and karma versus purification. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
With Narada's blessing Dhruva attained pure bhakti in six months, and his austerity shook the universe so that the demigods ran to Brahma. Bhakti and strong determination make the impossible possible. — “Bhakti will make impossible things possible.”

🎙 Maharaj at 00:13 (auto-transcript): “And Dabira Mahara did it. Six months, he attained pure bhakti. And not just attending pure bhakti, his bhakti shook the whole universe. All the demagogues went to Brahma. Is it the time of dissolution? What is happening? The Brahma said, no, my grandson is doing something…”

How will we get there living a mechanical, artificial life? Only devotional life gives this strength; a positive, favourable attitude is required.

🎙 Maharaj at 00:49 (auto-transcript): “How will we get there if we are continuing with the mechanical life? How will we get there? With the mechanical life, doing everything artificially? How will we get there? It is bhakti to give this strength. Mechanical life cannot give this strength for anybody. Devotional…”

It is true that Srila Prabhupada will take us back to Godhead — but he asked for 75 percent from us and promised the remaining 25. Without 100 percent we cannot go. — “So we have to practice our devotional life rigidly.”

🎙 Maharaj at 03:03 (auto-transcript): “Prabhupada will take you back to God's head. That is true. But how, how Papa will take you back to your follower, not imagining how to follow as it is. So Papa did not say, I will just take you. Say, you need 75%, then I will give the remaining 25%. That's what Papa promised.…”

children.topic: If not ready, go and sleep
children.note:
If you are not ready for rigid practice, Maharaj teases, go sleep till nine, eat in bed without brushing, and wait for Prabhupada to take you.

🎙 Maharaj at 04:13 (auto-transcript): “See, if you're not ready for rigid practice, don't come to Krishna consciousness. Go and sleep. sleep until nine o'clock you wake up don't brush your teeth on bed eat many people are doing like that eat then wait for proper to take you back to go yes wait very merciful you…”

children.topic: Saved so we can save others
children.note:
Check with Srila Prabhupada every day: what do you expect of me? He saved us so that we can save others — am I doing that? — “I'm saved so I can save others.”

🎙 Maharaj at 07:35 (auto-transcript): “Prabhupada is concerned about us. So every day we should check with Prabhupada. What are you expecting from me? What should I supposed to do? I'm here. So that Prabhupada saved us. Prabhupada did what? He saved us. To do what? Why did he save us? Why Prabhupada saved us?…”

Between guru and disciple, dealings are transparent when the interest is genuine. Maharaj contrasts the nishkapata disciple, free of duplicity, with the sakapata, who cheats.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:27 (auto-transcript): “So my dream only continues to speak about the transcendental dealings of disciples and the guru. their dealings will be transparent the dealing between disciples and gurus will be transparent be transparent it will be transparent if our interest is genuine”

Like the Pandavas, the sincere devotee stays joyful in the midst of difficulties and his faith in Krishna keeps growing.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:09 (auto-transcript): “everything is sweet the sweetness we are talking is not just that everything material is going wonderful in the midst of difficulties is very sweet that is this kaputabhakta that we saw with the pandavas were they distressed the pandavas were distressed in the middle of all…”

The duplicitous devotee feels everything as struggle and exhaustion; what he does is fatigue, not devotion, even if it brings him a big material position. — “Not devotional, it is fatigue”

🎙 Maharaj at 13:13 (auto-transcript): “Yes, devotees who struggle But not with Exhaustion And this Kapodipakta do not feel exhausted The Sakapodipakta feel exhausted Because what he is doing Is fatigue Not devotional, it is fatigue Fatigue This Kapodipakta May not have material Potition, may not May have, but may…”
Moved by Dhruva's words, Narada shows him causeless mercy and gives him advice. Maharaj reads the verse and purport.

The verse says expert advice, not just advice: for the devotee who receives it, success is already assured — there is no experiment to be made.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:44 (auto-transcript): “didn't say he gave him advice he gave him expert advice means what spot advice what does it mean this this art is already a success for this devotee who is getting this is a success he said devil will never meet with failure in devil it is only success export there is no…”

Narada benefits whomever he meets. Even with Kamsa and Hiranyakasipu he hastened their end so they would not keep piling up sin.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:59 (auto-transcript): “Whomever he meets. Narada Muni met Kamsa. Did he bless him? Right? Narada Muni met Kamsa. He saw Kamsa, many times. So, proper. Naturally, his only activity is to bestow the greatest benefit upon whomever he meet. He made Kamsa. He made Hira Kassipu. Right? He made them. What…”
Narada now tells Dhruva that his mother's instruction to take up devotional service suits him, and that he should absorb himself fully in it.

Narada first tested the boy — this is for great mystics, go home to your mother. The guru reveals more only after the disciple passes the test. — “He cannot reveal things to crooked devotees who are not sincere”

🎙 Maharaj at 19:20 (auto-transcript): “The Modi didn't give him a chance yet to do something else. Now he is giving this advice that he should absorb himself in devotional service to the Lord. He didn't tell him this in the beginning because he had to pass the test before. Something is revealed. The special Maasai…”

children.topic: Krishna responds to what is inside
children.note:
Krishna sits within, carefully watching. He responds not to what we do outside but to what is inside, and Narada had seen Dhruva's readiness. — “He will respond to what is there inside.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:23 (auto-transcript): “don't forget, Lord Krishna is sitting where, where Krishna is sitting what is he doing there what is Krishna doing there Very careful, watching everybody. There's no mistake. Watching. What is there? Krishna will respond to it. Not what we do outside. He will not respond. He…”

Absorption is what captures the mind. If our attention is on this world we are absorbed here; constant hearing about Krishna absorbs us in him. — “Absorption in Krishna comes when we constantly hear about Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:10 (auto-transcript): “Absorption in Krishna comes when we constantly hear about Krishna. If you are not hearing sufficiently about Krishna, no absorption. Absorption for the thing which will capture the mind, that is absorption. Anything which will not capture the mind, there is no absorption.…”
Worship of the Lord fulfils every human aim, Narada says, and sends Dhruva with his blessings to Madhuvana on the Yamuna.

Vrindavan is not only Raman Reti; it is the twelve forests, and Madhuvana is one of them. Krishna always lives there, so we live very close to him.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:03 (auto-transcript): “Christian always lives in Christian always live in Madhuvan Brandhavan, yes, that is Brandhavan Christian always lives in Brandhavan Madhuvan is Brandhavan Sometimes what you don't know When you say Brandhavan, what are you looking at? When you say Brandhavan, what do you…”

Dhruva passed the test, so he was blessed. We cannot demand blessings whimsically; please the spiritual master with sincere service and they come.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:25 (auto-transcript): “lada has blessed him with success why he passed the test he passed the test where he got blessed to be successful we cannot whimsically demand blessing from the special master you have to please him by sincere service so please the special master with sincere service then the…”

children.topic: The guru is one in interest
children.note:
Narada and Suniti gave the same instruction. 'Guru is one' does not mean eating and talking the same way; it means one interest — leading us to Krishna. — “Means they have the same interest”

🎙 Maharaj at 31:46 (auto-transcript): “Why? Because both of them are bona fide So we say Guru is one Guru is one doesn't mean They will eat the same thing They will drink the same thing They are going to talk the same way That is not the meaning Guru is one Guru is one Means they have the same interest Krishna The…”

children.topic: Narada and Suniti: levels of guru
children.note:
Both are gurus, but gurus have levels. Some are social and religious reformers who teach good behaviour but cannot take us to Godhead.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:57 (auto-transcript): “what is the difference both of them they have given the same instruction but so what is the difference and sunniti sunniti and the driver maharaj's mother sunniti what is the difference between them papa said both narada muni and sunniti the mother of durma haraj advise durma…”

Maharaj's first guru was Jesus, teaching love of neighbour — a human quality. Such teaching is needed today, since most have lost even that. — “majority of us doesn't have human qualities.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:38 (auto-transcript): “gurus have different levels not the same level they are gurus who are just the social reformers the social reformers they are they are encouraging people religiously honor your mother your father don't be disrespectful to be religious they they are gurus they're teaching…”

Suniti said go to the forest and approach God; Narada told how — the mantra, the place, the process. A guru makes practice easy.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:19 (auto-transcript): “what is elementary things are there so now that the money is especially giving him direction how this worship or the supreme person can very quickly achieved but the money is superior to Suniti he's giving the particularity because he knows Krishna he's guiding him how to get…”

Maharaj's brother saw an ISKCON notice in a newspaper and showed him; both came to the temple, but only Maharaj practised. His brother guided him, yet could not initiate him.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:24 (auto-transcript): “but the guidance general guidance is here just like a person the my brother when I was I was working that time with my brother well we're together we're living together he saw the advert of Krishna conscious in the newspaper and he's on who showed it to me that see see See,…”

Scripture sends us to holy places because sages live there. Racing for darshan without humility, to be first, defeats the purpose. — “you are just a spiritual tourist, you are not going anywhere.”

The point is to hear the pastimes from a sadhu in those places, as on ISKCON parikramas. Reading the same online or in a book is not the same — the potency is in hearing.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:49 (auto-transcript): “go visit the holy places because in these holy places say this lived or they frequent those places when we will have chance to hear krishnan kata from them and presently now in iscon you have the guru now taking you on parikama so the holy person is already there to hear kata…”

Five questions and comments after the class.

children.topic: Q1 · Why do devotees commit suicide?
children.note:
If the system works, why do some devotees commit suicide?

🎙 Question from the floor at 48:24 (auto-transcript): “Yes, taken to Krishna consciousness, especially sweet, right? This is very sweet. At the same time, we are seeing the world is not testing this, committing suicide, and it is happening again and again and again. So, naturally, the question comes to my mind, what is happening?…”

It is not normal; such a person saw nothing to live for. We are not dealing with each other as Prabhupada wanted, so all of us share the guilt.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:26 (auto-transcript): “question before are we dealing with each other with way proper relationship with us frankly speaking what is the answer no so that's encouraging some people can see that and become a threat that leads to a suicide so we all contributed for someone's committing suicide all of…”

The organisation's leaders should feel most guilty for not protecting devotees. Each of us should check whether our activities please Prabhupada.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:36 (auto-transcript): “third reason as an organization as an organization we the leaders should also feel guilty the most we should feel guilty the most that our leadership is not protecting devotees from ours so we are giving them insecurity that they are doing this we should also be seriously…”

children.topic: Q2 · Which way of following Prabhupada?
children.note:
Leaders stress different things — kirtan, book distribution, farms, a hospital. How should we see this?

🎙 Question from the floor at 54:58 (auto-transcript): “talking about like pleasing Srila Prabhupada. So what is the meaning of pleasing Srila Prabhupada? If somebody is pleasing Srila Prabhupada, so what will the outcome or the result we will be able to see? Because Prabhupada as an Acharya we find that practically Prabhupada…”

Book distribution, harinama, deity worship, preaching, farms, goshalas, hospitals — all are part of one system Prabhupada gave. Narrow-mindedness is the problem. — “The problem is that majority of us are one-sided”

🎙 Maharaj at 58:55 (auto-transcript): “There is a need for balance. All these different aspects you mentioned, they are all necessary. That is balance. Book distributors, book distribution, Haranam, Sankitan, deity worship, we call it preaching, farm community, goshala, everything, they are part of our system.…”

The test is our interest: helping people to Krishna, or expanding our own empire? A broad-minded devotee fits different people into different departments.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:32 (auto-transcript): “what is our interest in these things this project what is our interest in this project is it to help humanity or it is for expanding our own empire that is the point if it is for So, expanding Christian consciousness, thinking, properly use the word, devise many ways to…”

children.topic: Q3 · Must we be pure first?
children.note:
Do we need purity before we can serve?

🎙 Question from the floor at 62:53 (auto-transcript): “by 7.30 we don't need purity at our stage our purity our purity at our stage is to follow what the pure devotees are giving to us sincerely that is our purity the real purity to come later from our sincerely following this that is where our purity will come so we don't need…”

At our stage purity means sincerely following what pure devotees give; real purity comes from that. Srila Prabhupada is a first-class seer of truth; one who follows him sincerely is second-class.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:14 (auto-transcript): “do the right two classes of a bona fide I should use the word that I would use, Tatwa Dharasi, Tatwa Dharasi, there are two classes. First class Tatwa Dharasi, for example Prabhupada, second class Tatwa Dharasi who is following Prabhupada sincerely. So we will see from the…”

How should we deal with people who dislike us?

🎙 Question from the floor at 64:53 (auto-transcript): “When they don't have enemies, and if you have enemies over here, you said that, just don't have them. So, like, for enemies, like, you can acknowledge the things that they don't like, and you can minimize it, but not to hurt them, like, how do you do them? we don't need to…”

In the beginning, overlook with knowledge; gradually become like Prahlada, affectionate to all. When Daksa cursed Narada, Narada stayed — to bless him.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:34 (auto-transcript): “we don't need to have them we don't need to have them we shouldn't have enemies in the beginning, yeah, in the beginning we can yeah, overlook with knowledge, we can overlook them but eventually, as we grow we should grow to the stage where we remove all free, completely free…”

How do we know whether problems come from preaching or from not following properly?

🎙 Question from the floor at 68:37 (auto-transcript): “personally managing and creating the affairs also. So, at that time also we find that there have been challenges also in the society. Challenges is always there. What is the difference between the problems and how do we understand that problems are happening because we are…”

This world is wrongly constructed, like a house with leaking pipes and no light. Don't be surprised or meditate on problems — deal with them and move on.

🎙 Maharaj at 70:09 (auto-transcript): “It means what? It is meant for problem. Like you live in a bad house. A house because it's not properly constructed. Do you expect to be peaceful in that house? All the pipes are leaking. You wake up in the morning and see that all your load is sleeping on top of water. The…”

Misusing position and mistreating devotees brings karma as punishment. Problems that come while following sincerely are purification — and such devotees never think of leaving. — “that is not purification it is punishment”
